title: Head - NM Centre for Public Policy
jobDescription: The Head of the NM Centre for Public Policy leads research, dialogue, and advocacy for sustainable governance and societal development. Responsibilities include conducting evidence-based policy research in areas like health, education, and sustainability, organizing discussions with policymakers, and providing public policy training. This role also involves building partnerships with government bodies, think tanks, and nonprofits to support initiatives aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Candidates should have a master’s in public policy or a related field (Ph.D. preferred), at least seven years of policy experience, strong communication skills, and a track record in securing grants and leading multidisciplinary teams. Apply through the official KCT careers application portal.
